facts.text: Aman Tokyo is in the Otemachi Tower in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo.
facts.excerpt: The Otemachi Tower, 1-5-6 Otemachi, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo 100-0004

facts.text: Architect Kerry Hill played with the tenets of the Japanese house and its delineation of indoor and outdoor space in the lobby, using natural materials.
facts.excerpt: the now-deceased Kerry Hill—played with the tenets of the Japanese house, and its delineation of indoor and outdoor space in the lobby, using a bevy of natural materials

facts.text: Aman Tokyo was the first urban property from the Aman brand.
facts.excerpt: Aman Tokyo was the first urban essay by the brand—bringing nature into the city.

facts.text: At Musashi by Aman, chef Musashi serves omakase-style sushi and sashimi across a hinoki wood bar.
facts.excerpt: where the eponymous chef serves omakase-style sushi and sashimi to delighted diners from across the sweeping hinoki wood bar

facts.text: The rice that chef Musashi grows also goes into making his original sake and craft spirits.
facts.excerpt: The rice that chef Musashi grows also goes into making his original sake and craft spirits.

facts.text: The spa and wellness area covers 2,500 square metres over two floors.
The spa has eight treatment rooms.
facts.excerpt: Eight treatment rooms (with dressing room, treatment area, bathroom, steam shower and relaxation area)

facts.text: Suite stays include access to wellness facilities with Japanese-style bathing facilities, steam rooms, an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre.
facts.excerpt: Access to wellness facilities including Japanese-style bathing facilities, steam rooms, 30-metre indoor swimming pool and fitness centre

facts.text: Zazen meditation guided by a Japanese monk is offered.
facts.excerpt: High above Tokyo, experience the profound art of Zazen, a centuries-old practise rooted in Zen tradition, guided by a Japanese monk.

facts.text: Traditional Japanese acupuncture is available in the Aman Spa.
facts.excerpt: In the Aman Spa, traditional Japanese acupuncture is available to soothe pain and improve circulation

facts.text: Aman-led excursions in the Nihonbashi area let guests order custom kimono, engrave their own chopsticks and decorate handmade fans.
facts.excerpt: On an Aman-led excursion, guests can order custom kimono, engrave their own chopsticks, and decorate handmade fans

facts.text: Haneda Airport is a 40-minute drive from the hotel.
The language barrier can be a hurdle at Musashi by Aman for those who do not speak Japanese.
facts.excerpt: The language barrier can be somewhat of a hurdle at times for those who don’t speak Japanese

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists Aman Tokyo among its Readers' Choice Awards winners in 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2024 and 2025.
